Artifact.description:
An immutable, content-addressed artifact (§6.1).

The digest is the identity; everything else is provenance. Two retrievals of identical
bytes share one artifact, and the first retrieval's provenance is the one kept.

artifact_id.description: `art_<32 hex>`, derived from the digest; the handle callers pass to `read_artifact`.

compression.description: Transport compression that was removed before storage, e.g. `zstd`.

etag.description: HTTP validator, when the server supplied one.

final_url.description: Where it was actually served from after redirects, when different.

last_modified.description: HTTP validator, when the server supplied one.

media_type.description: Media type of the stored bytes (after any transport decompression).

retrieved_at.description: When it was retrieved, RFC 3339. Provenance only; never part of any identity.

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of the stored bytes, lower-case hex.

end.description: One past the last byte offset of the slice.

section.description: The section that was selected, when one was.

start.description: First byte offset of the slice.

Availability.description: What can and cannot be said about a symbol's availability to a project.

notes.description: Why the status is what it is, in prose.

Context.description: A context record (§6.1): a release, an environment and a research mode.

context_id.description: Derived from release, environment and mode.

environment_id.description: The environment it is studied in.

parent_context_id.description: The context this one was derived from, if any.

Deprecated.description: A deprecation notice as the producer recorded it.

DocsRsMetadata.description:
The nine `[package.metadata.docs.rs]` keys, with docs.rs' documented defaults (§4.3).

This is the *observed* configuration of the hosted build -- evidence for that documented
configuration, never the API enabled in a caller's project. `declared` says whether the
manifest carried the table at all, so a default is never mistaken for a maintainer choice.

additional_targets.description: Targets added to the default set.

cargo_args.description: Extra `cargo` arguments; these can change what compiles at all.

declared.description: Whether the manifest declared the table.

features.description: Features enabled for the docs build.

rustc_args.description: Extra `rustc` arguments; these can change what compiles at all.

targets.description: Explicit target list, when set; `None` means docs.rs' tier-one default set.

default_features.description: Whether default features are enabled. `None` when unspecified.

features.description: Enabled features or extras, sorted and deduplicated.

lock_digest.description: Digest of the dependency lock, when one was supplied.

resolution.description: How much of this environment is known.

target.description: Target triple or platform tag, when known.

toolchain.description: Compiler or interpreter identity, when known.

EvidenceFragment.description: A bounded extract with its locator and epistemic class (§6.1).

artifact_id.description: The artifact it was read from.

evidence_class.description: Which epistemic class it belongs to.

kind.description: What kind of text this is.

locator.description: Position within the artifact, as a JSON object.

subject.description: What it is about: a symbol path, a feature name, a heading.

Gap.description: One piece of expected evidence that is absent, with why and what would supply it.

detail.description: Human-readable detail, e.g. the format version that was refused.

planned_fallback.description: The producer and profile that would supply it, when one exists.

HostedJsonReport.description: The hosted rustdoc JSON facet of a resolution.

declared_crate_version.description: `crate_version` as the JSON itself declares it, when available.

format_version.description: The format version the payload declared, when one was read.

supported_formats.description: The format versions this build can interpret.

target.description: The target the JSON was requested for.

also_at.description: Other public paths to the same definition.

availability.description: What can and cannot be said about availability.

candidates.description: Candidate paths when the reference was ambiguous or unqualified.

symbol.description: The symbol, when one was selected. Its `docs` are bounded here.

ManifestData.description: The snapshot manifest resource: what a snapshot contains.

is_current.description: Whether this snapshot is the context's current one.

NamespaceFacet.description: A namespace facet in an overview.

children.description: A bounded sample of direct children, definitions counted once.

counts_by_kind.description: Distinct definitions directly under this module, by kind.

doc_summary.description: First paragraph of the module docs.

ObservedConfiguration.description: The configuration a documentation build was observed under (§4.3).

features.description: Features the docs build enabled, as the manifest declared them.

source.description: Where the configuration was read from.

target.description: The target the JSON itself declares.

OverviewChild.description: One child in a namespace sample.

is_reexport.description: Whether this path re-exports a definition elsewhere.

OverviewData.description: The `library_overview` payload (§7.1: a tree and facets, never a symbol dump).

area.description: The subtree the overview was narrowed to, when any.

crate_version.description: The crate version the documentation declares.

definitions_by_kind.description: Distinct definitions by kind across the area.

features.description: Feature definitions: name and what it enables.

reexports.description: Paths that re-export a definition reachable elsewhere.

unresolved_reexports.description: Re-exports whose target is outside this crate.

PlannedFallback.description: A producer that could supply missing evidence, and whether policy currently allows it.

enabled.description: Whether configuration currently enables that profile.

next_action.description: What a caller or operator would do to make it run.

config_digest.description: Digest of the normalized options the run was configured with.

gaps.description: Evidence the run was expected to yield and did not, each with a reason.

log.description: Bounded log text, when any was kept.

profile.description: The execution profile the run was performed under.

source_path.description: The source path, for display without a join.

target_id.description: The target symbol or definition, when it is in this snapshot.

target_path.description: The target path as written, even when the target is external.

Release.description:
A release record (§6.1).

Package name, library target name and root module name are three different things for a
Rust crate (`serde-json` / `serde_json` / `serde_json`) and are stored separately.

artifact_digest.description: The registry checksum of the selected artifact, when the registry publishes one.

lib_name.description: The library target name declared in the manifest, when known.

package.description: The normalized package name as the registry knows it.

published_at.description: Publication time as the registry records it.

registry.description: The registry the package was resolved against, e.g. `crates.io`.

root_module.description: The root module name as it appears in `use` paths, when known.

rust_version.description: Minimum supported Rust version as published.

version.description: The exact version, or an immutable revision for `revision` mode.

yanked.description: Whether the registry has yanked this version.

ReleaseLinks.description: Links a registry publishes for a release.

RequestedConfiguration.description: What a caller declared about its own environment, for comparison.

default_features.description: Whether default features are enabled, when declared.

features.description: Features the project enables, when declared.

answered_from_cache.description: Whether this answer was replayed from a recorded resolution rather than fetched.

artifacts.description: Every artifact this resolution stored or reused.

context.description: The context identity every later call takes.

environment.description: The environment the context binds, with its resolution status.

gaps.description: Expected evidence that is absent, each with a reason and a planned fallback.

observed_configuration.description: The maintainer's docs.rs build configuration, read from the crate manifest.

producer_runs.description: Provenance for each producer that ran.

release.description: The release that was resolved. Its version is the one asked for, never an upgrade.

snapshot.description: The snapshot published from this resolution, when normalization succeeded.

upstream.description: What the registry said about newer releases, kept apart from the resolution.

scoring.description: The scoring legend, in rank order.

tokens.description: The tokens it was split into.

also_at.description: Other public paths to the same definition.

evidence_id.description: The evidence entry this hit is cited by.

SnapshotCounts.description: Counts an overview and a manifest report.

producer_items.description: Items the producer saw in total, including those not surfaced as symbols.

reexports.description: Paths that re-export a definition reachable elsewhere.

unresolved_reexports.description: Re-exports whose target is outside this crate.

SnapshotManifest.description: The immutable description of one snapshot (§6.1).

crate_name.description: The crate name as rustdoc knows it.

crate_version.description: The crate version the JSON declared.

items.description:
The kinds of evidence a producer can require or yield, and that `coverage.indexed` and
`coverage.missing` name.

The values are, in order: `registry_metadata`, `crate_source`,
`documentation_build_config`, `hosted_rustdoc_json`, `public_api`, `documentation`,
`examples`, `release_notes`, `source_excerpts`.

missing.description: Evidence kinds that were expected and are absent.

items.description:
The kinds of evidence a producer can require or yield, and that `coverage.indexed` and
`coverage.missing` name.

The values are, in order: `registry_metadata`, `crate_source`,
`documentation_build_config`, `hosted_rustdoc_json`, `public_api`, `documentation`,
`examples`, `release_notes`, `source_excerpts`.

producer_runs.description: Every producer run that fed this snapshot.

SnapshotSummary.description: What the published snapshot holds, summarized.

SourceExcerpt.description: A bounded source excerpt around a line, for `inspect_symbol` at `source` depth.

path.description: The file, relative to the crate root.

truncated.description: Whether the file had more lines after `end_line`.

Symbol.description:
One public symbol at one public path (§6.1).

A re-export is a symbol whose `path` differs from its `definition_path`; both share one
`definition_id`, which is how an overview counts capabilities once (gate R07).

cfg_hints.description:
`cfg`-shaped attribute strings the producer preserved, as declared hints only. Never
a feature predicate: items compiled out are absent, not annotated (§4.3).

defined_in_crate.description: The crate the definition belongs to.

definition_id.description: Identity of the definition this path names.

definition_path.description: The path the item is defined at.

doc_summary.description: First paragraph of the documentation, bounded.

is_reexport.description: Whether this path is a re-export of a definition elsewhere.

kind.description: What kind of item this is.

producer_local_id.description: The producer's own item identifier -- local, never a cross-release identity.

signature.description: Rendered signature, when the producer rendered one.

span_file.description: Source file as the producer recorded it.

span_line.description: 1-based source line as the producer recorded it.

symbol_id.description:
Identity of this public path: hash of crate, path, kind and (for trait-impl members)
the trait.

TableRef.description: A table stored in a snapshot.

file.description: File name within the snapshot directory.

UpstreamCheck.description: What the registry says about newer releases, kept separate from what was resolved.

newest_any.description: Newest non-yanked version of any kind.

published_versions.description: Number of published versions the index listed.

resolved_is_newest_stable.description: Whether the resolved version is the newest stable one.

description: Every tool payload, for schema emission. Never sent on the wire as a union.
title: LibraryEnrichmentToolData
